key_insight: The work highlights a jet regime where compressible and incompressible dynamics coexist, revealing that both flow descriptions can matter in the same physical system.
engineering_relevance: Understanding this mixed-flow behavior can improve modeling and design of high-speed jets, where accurate prediction of density and velocity fluctuations is important.
method: Analyzed jet behavior for signatures of both compressible and incompressible motion.
Compared flow structures to identify where each dynamical regime dominates.
Presented the findings as part of a Gallery of Fluid Motion poster visualization.
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates this is a poster-based visualization study from the APS DFD Gallery of Fluid Motion rather than a numerical benchmark or dataset-driven evaluation.
watch_item: Because the abstract provides only a poster summary, the quantitative scope and generalizability of the reported flow regime separation are unclear.
paper_title: Jet coronation: Coexistence of compressible and incompressible dynamics
